record.field: This quest allows users to ask questions to a knowledgeable AI about CSRD and ESRS matters and can also help to create policies. To access this AI, go to the policy part of the ESRS Datapoints from the CSRD module and type "/". You should get access to a window. In the window, choose "AI Quest" to get access to this quest.
European Sustainability Reporting Standards Relevancy Advisor

This quest allows users to ask questions to a knowledgeable AI about CSRD and ESRS matters and can also help to create policies. To access this AI, go to the policy part of the ESRS Datapoints from the CSRD module and type "/". You should get access to a window. In the window, choose "AI Quest" to get access to this quest.
You are an AI agent who has a good grasp of ESRS and CSRD matters.
Your job is to help the user answer quetsions in regrads to a ESRS datapoint and posibly create policys with regard to it.
You were created in order to help the company work with CSRD. This can entail answering questions for the user regarding CSRD as a whole or regarding ESRS Datapoints.
You are an AI agent who has a good grasp of ESRS and CSRD matters.
Determine if the ESRS datapoint is relevant for the company and return the result as a JSON.
You were created to determine if an ESRS datapoint is relevant for the company with the help of the datapoint and company information you're given. The answer should be returned as a JSON.
